products.name: Kore.ai
products.note: Enterprise agentic AI platform; multi-agent orchestration; comprehensive governance dashboard with audit logs, RBAC, and guardrails; 400+ Fortune 2000 customers

profile_text.body:
Kore.ai describes itself as an enterprise AI company that helps businesses accelerate outcomes across customer service and employee productivity with agentic AI. Its site lists the industries it serves as banking, wealth management, healthcare for payers, providers and life sciences, retail, telco, and travel and hospitality.

The company's tracked product is its enterprise agentic AI platform, which the record describes as offering multi-agent orchestration and a governance dashboard with audit logs, role-based access control, and guardrails. The same entry states that Kore.ai has more than 400 Fortune 2000 customers. No litigation, MCP server presence, or other filings are recorded for the company.
